statement: This sketch depicts a dense network of steam pipes and underground utility veins rendered in a thick, wet black ink style on aged yellowed newsprint. The composition features overlapping lines with varying stroke weights that suggest both the physical presence of industrial infrastructure and the fluid motion of steam through pipes. The organic curves and bleeding edges create a sense of movement and pressure within the static image, while the textured background evokes the patina of old industrial documents. The viewer is invited to explore the complex interweaving of these utility networks, where the thick ink lines appear to absorb into the paper, suggesting both permanence and the passage of time in an industrial landscape.
